description: This file provides utility functions to format currency amounts consistently across a software application. It handles formatting USD values with dynamic decimal precision, optional inclusion of credits, and fallback formatting. It also includes helper functions for specific USD formatting scenarios.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with options for currency code, decimal precision, and credits inclusion. Uses Intl.NumberFormat for locale-aware formatting and applies dynamic decimal precision based on the value magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function to format a USD amount with optional credits appended, utilizing 'formatCurrencyAmount' with defaults suited for USD.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with thousands separator and up to six decimal places, tailored for precise USD display.
